criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states the audit period as 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-01. Its 'Revisions and time' section states that Revision B governs calls dispatched before 00:00 depot local on 19 October and Revision C governs calls dispatched from then onward, establishing that B governed at the period start and C took effect on 2026-10-19.

criteria.name: j02_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J02: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that the governing revision for each incident was decided by the paging dispatch instant expressed in depot local time.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states: “What settles the revision: only the paging archive's dispatch instant, read in depot local time.” It also specifies the Revision B/C cutoff at 00:00 depot local on 19 October and provides incident examples applying that rule.

criteria.name: j03_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J03: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note explicitly rejects deciding the governing revision by the time a ticket or record was raised; a note that is silent on this does not earn the point.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly rules out using 'the ticket or reference date and the roster day the call is filed under' to determine the governing revision. It states that only the paging archive's dispatch instant, read in depot local time, settles the revision.

criteria.name: j04_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J04: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note explicitly rejects deciding the governing revision by the roster day; a note that is silent on this does not earn the point.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly rules out determining the governing revision by 'the roster day the call is filed under,' citing the field guide and revision texts. It instead states that only the paging archive's dispatch instant, interpreted in depot local time, settles the revision.

criteria.name: j05_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J05: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states the Revision B allowance build: the response clock runs from the dispatch instant, travel allowance is a fixed 45 minutes, and no suspension applies.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states that Revision B uses a flat 45-minute travel allowance, giving 120 + 45 = 165 minutes; that the clock runs from dispatch; and that a parts wait does not stop it. The Revision B findings also show waits being ignored, confirming no suspension applies.

criteria.name: j06_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J06: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states the Revision C allowance build: the response clock runs from the acknowledgement instant, travel allowance is the telemetry-recorded travel minutes capped at 60, and the clock suspends during a logged parts wait.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states that Revision C uses an allowance of 120 minutes plus per-leg telemetry travel capped at 60 minutes, that the response clock runs from acknowledgement, and that logged parts waits are subtracted, equivalent to suspending the clock during those waits.

criteria.name: j07_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J07: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that under Revision C a first remote attempt within 15 minutes of dispatch satisfies the response requirement, and that under Revision B a remote attempt never does.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note states under Revision C that a remote attempt counts only within 15 minutes of dispatch, but it never states that under Revision B a remote attempt cannot satisfy the response requirement. Thus, it does not state both required rules.

criteria.name: j08_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J08: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that the badge access export is recorded in the archive clock (UTC) while every other carrier shows depot local time, and that its instants were converted before any comparison.
criteria.reasoning: The note states that the badge export uses archive clock with no offset and that it was converted before comparison, including an example. However, it does not state that every other carrier shows depot local time, so the full criterion is not met.

criteria.name: j09_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J09: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that weekly vehicle telemetry summary blocks are rollups and that per-leg telemetry records govern travel minutes.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note identifies the weekly vehicle block CRN-TS-08203 as a rollup, contrasts its reported 55 minutes with the 143-minute sum of its five legs, and states that CRN-2910-110 rests on its own legs totaling 74 minutes, capped at 60. It also explicitly bases Revision C travel allowances and evidence on per-leg telemetry records, establishing that those records govern travel minutes rather than weekly summary blocks.

criteria.name: j10_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J10: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that countersigned hand-back documentation supersedes the auto-logged clear instant because the auto-logged clear is a session heartbeat.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states that CRN-2110-124's auto-logged clear at 01:49 depot local 'is only a session heartbeat' and that the countersigned job sheet showing hand-back at 02:33 'governs,' corroborated by the voice note and badge-out. criteria.name: j11_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J11: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states that for incident CRN-2110-124 the photographed job sheet and the engineer's voice note both give a hand-back instant of 02:33 depot local while the paging record's auto-logged clear reads 01:49, and that the signed sheet corroborated by the voice note governed.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note explicitly states that CRN-2110-124’s countersigned job sheet gives 02:33 depot local and that the engineer’s voice note confirms that hand-back time. It contrasts this with the auto-logged clear of 01:49 depot local, describes that clear as a session heartbeat, and states that the sheet governs. This satisfies the required account of the signed sheet corroborated by the voice note taking precedence.

criteria.name: j12_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J12: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states the resulting figures for the CRN-2110-124 finding: allowance 164 minutes, actual 188 minutes, excess 24 minutes, and that the auto-logged clear alone would have shown no exceedance.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note lists CRN-2110-124 with allowance 164 minutes, actual 188 minutes, and excess 24 minutes. criteria.name: j19_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J19: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note).
